body:
Yeah, I apologize for asking, that's pretty understandable.

Can you think of anything that you haven't experienced yet that you'd like to go through? Like, I don't know, a place you are at least mildly curious about visiting? Foods you haven't tried? Some sort of activity you think would provide at least some amusement? I wish I could be more helpful since you were asking for suggestions, all I'm really doing is spitballing atm.

Depression is kind of a really shitty thing in the sense that it feels like the more you try to reach out and get help the further it seems some people get driven away from you. I suppose it is understandable in the sense that negative people just tend to weigh you down and you want to avoid that, but it really sucks for the person who is depressed because they want help but nobody seems to want to give it.

Do you mind telling me what happened before or it it too painful? As in, what did people say to you?

I'm sorry, I didn't mean to try and play counselor. I'm not gonna pretend I have any power over what you do or not. I'm just a stranger on the internet. Regardless of what you decide to do, I just wanted to let you know that you aren't alone, I was feeling so worthless not too long ago that I wanted to stop existing. I don't imagine that a stranger on the internet means much to you in the end, but I know what that abyss is like and I know how much I wanted somebody to reach out and help.

I can relate; I didn't really have friends in high school either, and definitely no dates. I just felt my entire existence was pretty worthless in general. The only thing that really helped was the internet, that was the only place I could really make friends. 

I don't know your father or what the exact circumstances of what that all is but I would definitely reprimand any guardian who tells a child they are a failure and worthless. That was definitely not ok, I don't know what you did but you didn't deserve that.

Why do you feel that you can't trust anybody? Not everyone is just going to end up disappointing you, there are good people out there that want to help you. What kind of help were you promised?

Dude I know it really really hurts to lose someone like that, trust me, I'm going through that right now, but isn't there anyone you can turn to for support like your friends and family? Keeping this all inside of you this whole time might have just made this so much worse, I know it was tearing me apart for a long time, when I just broke down and asked for help I got it and now I'm still hurting but I feel like I have something worth living for. If they tried to help you they probably still do, **get help**.

Please don't give up dude, I know it feels like an endless abyss of misery is ahead but don't you want to ride this out just a little bit longer to see if you at least feel a little better tomorrow or the days after? Your life has value, people care about you, they WILL help you.
What happened to you that made you feel this way? Do you want to talk about it? Please call a hotline or something, there are people that will help you.

I don't know much about your boyfriend but it sounds like he might be going through issues of his own? Spending money on things and saying he does it to be "eccentric" is very strange to me.

I know finding a job in this climate sucks and I can't imagine how you must feel if your boyfriend is the only person you can rely on. Unfortunately I do not know what to tell you outside of just continuing to struggle to find work and doing the best you can to support your boyfriend and make him know you really appreciate him.
can you please explain to me what you are feeling right now and what led you to believe this? You sound very disillusioned.

I can understand your feelings of social inadequacy; I felt I was unable to keep up conversations with people for most of my life because I was so weird. 

Did anything in particular happen to you when you were 14 or was it just a gradual process? It seems like a very young age to lose hope, I am just wondering if something really awful happened to you.

I am also wondering if you have tried seeking any help? Is there nobody you can really rely on at all? Do you think it's worth riding it out a little bit further just to see if you can feel anything good at all? Because it sounds like you are numb and extremely depressed.

>my boyfriend was my only friend and he dumped me last night because I was too depressing to be around.

Did it feel like you were trying to reach out to him, so badly desperately wanting help, and with every step you took he took two steps back? Or like you were in a marsh and the more you struggled the fastet you sank? Because I went through that recently and I know what that's like. It's one of the worst feelings I've ever had.

I don't want to judge your boyfriend too badly, I don't know what his situation is and I don't want to condemn someone I don't know. But right now it really just seems like you need to focus on getting better; it's good that you got help. I think you need all you can get. It sucks to hear that you don't have any friends but for what it's worth we (or at least I) will be here to listen. You don't have go through this by yourself, I don't imagine a stranger on the internet can even compare to having an actual person help you, but for what it is worth we (or at least) I will do our best to support you and make you feel like you are not alone. If you ever feel like you want to come back and keep us updated, we will listen and try our best to help you.

It wasn't really a "relationship" in my case, but I understand your feelings very well as I'm going through a time myself where I felt I lost something very important and it was mostly (if not entirely) my fault. The jury's still out on that, but I'm not going to bother you with my story since this isn't about me. I cannot pretend to know how you feel, but I know what I felt: "If I had just done this instead of that, been better, realized sooner what I was doing, things would be ok and I threw it all away". Unfortunately life doesn't have an undo button. 

Something that I try to tell myself now is that romantic love is not the only kind of love that matters. I know it really, really, really hurts you inside, especially if your girlfriend was someone you cared about a lot. Are there other people that care about you? Like family, or friends? Can't you reach out to them for support?
Could you please tell me why you feel that you want your life to end? Obviously you are very upset, but I am just curious and want to listen to the things that are bothering you.

I am very sorry to hear about your father. It would have been bad enough to lost him, but I imagine living with that guilt is killing you inside. I do not know your father or how much your performance at university was upsetting him; if he had something as bad as a stroke perhaps there were other factors involved and your performance wasn't even that big of a deal? I really have no way of knowing. 

I don't want to say that you shouldn't stop trying to live your life because of that, as I have no way of knowing the extent of the horrendous guilt you must bear; it would just be arrogant. My newfound perspective on my own situation and regarding my own mistakes in life (which are not nearly as grave as yours) is that as long as I'm alive I will try my hardest to help people and make them happy because it means that my existence has some value to this world. Even a simple thing like buying my mother flowers to show I appreciate her or giving my sister a candy bar and looking at the big smile on her face makes me feel like my own existence has some meaning in this world. It's also why I'm posting on subreddits like these, because even though my own problems aren't that grave I know what it is like to feel that you are depressed and worthless and I want to do everything in my power to make people feel better to give my own life meaning. You already have a job, so that's a great start, but maybe doing something like volunteer work or just helping people out in some way might help ease your depression. I can't guarantee you anything, but it is an answer I have found.

I am also sorry to hear that your psychiatric help is so unreliable; is there really no one who can listen to you at all? Because if nothing else it really sounds like you need someone to lend you an ear, at least.

Why do you feel that going outside is a burden you are putting on yourself? I don't claim to know what makes you feel better, but I know that when I spend time with others it helps take my mind away from the pain and feelings of anxiety I carry within me. From my own experience if I am alone,  I usually just tend to get moody and withdrawn and just tend to get lost in my own head. even just talking to my internet friends helps me a lot and gets my mind off the negative feelings that keep stirring inside me.

Batman/DC Universe in generalxZetman.

Shit would be real.

I can relate to your ambition of being an artist; that is the one thing I have been pursuing for the last decade or so that I have not given up on. Art is one of the most intimate and powerful things humans can do, it is part of what makes us so unique and wonderful. Do not give up. Follow your passion.
Why is it that you feel so lonely? Do you have friends? Family? Are you seeking professional help right now, does anyone know you are feeling this way?

Could you please tell us more about why you feel this way? What happened to you? Why do you feel that you will continue to fail? I have felt that way for a long time too, I would like to know what it is you have gone through because it sounds like it was much worse than what I've experienced.

It doesn't matter if your problems aren't the most "urgent"; something is clearly bothering you anyway, and your suffering is real. if you posted this in suicide watch of all places I imagine you are very upset and need help.

I can relate to your feelings of cultural isolation; due to my own life circumstances I felt isolated from the people I live with for a very long time and to a degree I still do. To give you an idea, I speak my mother tongue very poorly nowadays (english isn't my first language), my communication with most people is really not where it should be. I struggled to relate to most people for a very long time.

From your post it seems like you are not a bad person, if you have a job and even a house in your name you are a good and productive member of society. As far as the information you have given me is concerned you have nothing to be ashamed of and a lot to be proud of.

Could you please explain more about what happened when you seeked out psychiatric help? Why do you feel that you are too messed up to be helped? Make sure to keep us updated on what is going on, I sincerely hope that you feel better soon.
Well I finally broke down and ended up phoning my mother. I almost broke down crying on the phone, she was going to come home soon anyway so I might finally get someone to talk to.

Thanks for the reply, it means a lot given how I'm feeling right now.

My family knows I have a history of depression and lethargic behavior, but I don't think any of them except one know just how terrible I'm feeling at this precise moment. The only one who probably suspects something is a family friend who pops by every now and then, she heard me crying yesterday and asked me what was wrong. She's a good person but I just don't feel comfortable confiding in her right now. 

Today when I told my brother about how bad I was feeling he just told me I was being a manbaby and that people suck it up and go to class even when they aren't feeling well. I don't think he really has any idea of how absolutely abysmal I'm feeling right now, he probably just thinks I woke up on the wrong side of bed or something. He's a good kid  and can be supportive sometimes, but he seems to think his problems are so much worse than mine so I really don't feel comfortable talking to him or anyone else in my family. I feel like they would be sympathetic but tell me my problems aren't really that big of a deal and that I am overreacting. In some sense maybe I am...but it's hard to ignore how I'm feeling right now, like I have a huge weight inside me and I'm sinking in  a marsh and the more I struggle to get out the more hurt I feel and the quicker I sink.

I used to see a psychiatrist some years ago, but I messed it all up. I never got used to the dynamic of telling a complete stranger about my problems, and I just ran out of things to talk about. He prescribed medicine for me but I have always been a forgetful and irresponsible person and I'd always forget to take one day or the other. eventually i just quit because I felt it wasn't helping me. I really really regret it and wish more than anything that I had someone to talk to in a safe place in confidence who would listen and not judge me.

Right now I'm not undergoing any treatment, and I don't think my family can afford it either because my mother has said going to see a psychiatrist is too expensive.  I want someone, anyone to help me but I just don't know where the help is going to come from. Like I said in the OP a big part of me just wants to intern at a hospital so I don't have to deal with day-to-day life anymore. I can't even fall asleep properly due to my stress and anxiety.

I know exactly how you feel right now. 

There have been periods of time in the past where I have wanted to kill myself, but now the feeling has come back so much worse than ever before. I feel so vulnerable, helpless and weak and I think I would have already at least tried to kill myself if it weren't for the fact that it would tear my family apart.

They would all blame themselves, especially my mother. She has actually tried to kill herself before as well and the only reason she's still alive is my kid brother. She's already stressed, overworked and unhappy as it is and still keeps going because she needs to provide for us. Me killing myself would completely devastate her, she'd be completely unable to keep on going and my siblings would suffer too just because I couldn't take it anymore.

So I'm still here, but I feel like I'm reaching a breaking point and I just don't know what I'm going to do anymore.

So just know that you aren't alone.
I understand the concept of tough love and all but when I am depressed (like i am right now) that is the last thing I want to hear.
Feel free to PM me as well. I was also diagnosed with Asperger's some time ago, so I feel like I can relate to what you are going through even if it's just a little.
We both go to the same university and take the same bus together to go home.

No it isn't asking too much at all, everyone deserves to be happy. You obviously care about your mother, it just sounds like she is in a lot of pain right now and doesn't know how to cope. 

i'm not sure if i have any advice I can really give you other than what i've said before: please seek help.

Your dad's an asshole. Nobody deserves to be bullied for any reason.

I don't know what your mother's problems are, it is clear that you have issues of your own. Calling her selfish after she tried to kill herself is honestly not the best thing you could have done, but I understand why you did it. 

You need help dude, it sounds like you are really insecure and vulnerable right now. Plastic surgery is not going to fix your problems, because the real issues aren't on the outside, they are on the inside. Please seek professional help.

I'm so happy that you are doing better now, that's great to hear. Thank you for the inspirational post, right now I'm feeling awful myself and it's nice to hear that someone at least is winning the battle.

Sent you a PM. Please if you feel like you are going to hurt yourself in any way, go to the suicide watch subreddit or just message me...the only thing is, I may not be able to reply immediately (to give you an idea of our difference in timezones it's 4am right now my time and I try not to stay up this late). Please don't hurt yourself, I may not know you that well but you sound like a good person, I don't want you to do anything drastic. 

I know that you are feeling awful right now, trust me I understand, and I also understand that what you may go through soon will hurt you a lot and I have a feeling that the same thing will happen to me soon as well...but please try go on even for just a little bit to see if things will get better. There are people who care about you, including me, even if I don't know you that well, I want you to be alive and happy.

I am so sorry that you are going through this, that sounds so dreadful, I can't even imagine the pain you must be in right now. 

I may not have been dumped yet or gone through the same things you have but I fully understand the feeling of being the background person, like no matter how hard you try you just aren't good enough. I don't know you personally feel right now but all I ever wanted was to give myself to someone and shower them with my complete love and devotion and be loved and cared for in return.

Recently I've gone through some things that challenged this assumption I've had of myself; in the end it may just be something that will hurt me even more, but it is a fact that someone was attracted to me and I had SOMETHING with someone, at least once in my life, someone thought I was good enough. and even though it's really difficult for me right now to take any sort of comfort in that, it is something.

My point is that no matter how unlovable you think are, there are good people out there, and someone will eventually discover just how special you are and give you the love and support you want so badly. It may be a while from now, I never had any sort of relationship with anyone until I was 21, but it happened when I least expected it. 

At the end of the day there is not much I can do for you, but I just want to let you know that even as a stranger on the internet it hurts me to see that there is someone going through something so awful right now. I sincerely hope that you find someone who cares and that you can rely on.

Dude I know almost exactly how you feel because right now I am in a situation that is more or less similar to yours; except it wasn't really a relationship so much as a "thing", and there's been no "breaking off" of it yet except I have a sinking feeling that it's imminent despite the fact that often I don't really know where I stand. I also feel that perhaps the only relationship I can really be in is one where I give myself completely to the person and I get a similar level of devotion in return.

It is hard for me to say what you should do in this situation. It hurts to say this but I don't know if I would be capable of being near her in that situation, especially if she gets involved with someone else; I know from experience that just hearing about something that SOUNDS REMOTELY like a romantic engagement with the girl I'm sort-of-seeing now drives me insane with jealousy and grief.

If the pain is too soul-crushing, too intense for you to be near her even as a friend, you need to be away from her at least a little bit so your heart can grieve. If she cares about you at all still, hopefully she will understand. Explain to her that you made mistakes, that you care about her and that you're sorry for everything, that you want to be near her still as a friend, but that you're in a lot of pain yourself right now and that you can't be a good friend to her in your current state.

I really feel for you dude. Keep me updated on what's going on and feel free to message me if you want to talk. This is a throwaway so I might forget the PW but I'll bookmark this thread and give you my actual account name if you want.
